outcome.description: delivered: in the business's inbox. confirm: nothing sent yet, the terms are for your person to confirm. times: the free times, nothing sent. not_free: that time is not free, nothing sent. refused: the inbox refused it (its words say why). busy: the inbox asked for a pause. failed: the inbox could not be reached. switched_off: the business does not take requests carried by a network. no_inbox: the business has no inbox to carry it to, or its inbox has not said it takes requests carried by a network. not_taken: its inbox does not take this kind of request. elsewhere: it takes this kind somewhere else.

delivered.description: Whether the request is in the business's inbox now.

inbox.description: The business's own inbox, where the request went.

item.description: The request as the inbox keeps it.

status_url.description: Where its state can be read, with access_token.

access_token.description: The inbox gives it once, to read or cancel this request at status_url: keep it for your person only.

access_token_withheld.description: A repeat of a request already delivered: the inbox gives the access token only the first time.

replayed.description: The same request again: the inbox answered as it did the first time.

answer.description: The business's own words about the request, from its inbox: tell your person as they are.

summary.description: The terms in the business's words: show your person this, as it is.

terms_sha.description: Send it back as terms_sha only after your person said yes.

service.description: The service a booking is for.

services.description: The services the business books, when service named none of them.

times.description: Free times, in UTC; timezone says the business's own, the clock to tell your person.

elsewhere.description: Where the business takes this kind of request instead.

kept.description: What this network keeps of the request.
